question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are holding a white elephant gift exchange. At the start of the event, they are each holding a present of a different color: Alice has a white present, Bob has a silver present, and Claire has a purple present.
As the event progresses, pairs of people swap gifts. First, Claire and Bob swap their gifts. Then, Alice and Claire swap their gifts. Finally, Alice and Claire swap their gifts. At the end of the event, Bob has the
Options:
(A) white present
(B) silver present
(C) purple present
solution:
Initial: Alice = white present; Bob = silver present; Claire = purple present.
1. Claire and Bob swap: Alice = white present; Bob = purple present; Claire = silver present.
2. Alice and Claire swap: Alice = silver present; Bob = purple present; Claire = white present.
3. Alice and Claire swap: Alice = white present; Bob = purple present; Claire = silver present.
Bob has the purple present, option (C).
Final answer: (C)
